title: Owner-gate route authz call sites and CI-config files
acceptance: The owner gate covers files whose edits can remove authz or disable a CI check: route files with requireAccess call sites (apps/api/src/routes/*, lib/member-target.ts) and CI-config files (eslint config, .prettierignore, Playwright and vitest configs, e2e/serve.mjs, scripts/tasks.mjs, .nvmrc), or the owner records why a class stays ungated, plus provider/OAuth integration tests, apps/api/src/lib/deploy-script.test.ts, e2e/package.json and packages/shared/package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, and the Live readiness UI (LivePreflight, LiveTimeline, lib/live-readiness).
The added friction is weighed against the owner already approving every merge; the decision is recorded.
Also consider rate-limit.ts, routes/mock.ts and lib/mock-catalog.ts, lib/connection-return.ts, and the PWA recovery files.
nextAction: Owner decides whether to gate route and CI-config files, given every merge already needs per-PR permission.

evidence.summary: Final review #2 of #643 (findings 4 and 5): removing a requireAccess call in a route, or switching a CI check off via its config, is not owner-gated. Deferred by the owner on 2026-10-27 because the gate is a guardrail and every merge needs owner permission.
Review #3 gated agent prompts, the task/handoff READMEs and the Live/provider UI components in #643. Route authz call sites and CI-config files remain ungated and are still this task's scope.
Final review #4 of #643 (finding 8) added ungated test and package paths to this task's scope.
Final review #6 of #643 added pnpm-lock.yaml and the Live readiness UI to this task's ungated-coverage scope.

Final review #8 of #643 added rate-limit.ts, the mock route and catalog, connection-return.ts and the PWA recovery files (applyServiceWorkerUpdate, lazyWithReload, pwa-config test) to this task's ungated scope.
